content: अवरुह् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To descend, alight, go down to; कूपम् पन्थानम् <ab>&c.</ab>; come down (in general); to dismount, get down; यानासनस्थश्चैवैनमवरुह्याभिवादयेत् <ls>Ms. 2. 202</ls>; <ls>R. 4. 80</ls>; <ls>Bk. 8. 104</ls>; so प्रासादात्, वृक्षाग्रात्; ऐश्वर्यात् अवरूढः come down from, bereft of, prosperity. .²2 To approach; अचिरादवरोत्स्यसि <ls>Bhāg. 3. 33. 10</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} रोहयति or रोपयति .²1 To cause to descend or alight; तामवारोहयत् <ls>R. 1. 54</ls>; helped her down; to bring down, or set down; तां सरस्तीरेऽवरोप्य <ls>Dk. 139</ls>; वृक्षाद्धनूंषि, गाण्डीविम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 To lower, lessen, reduce; <ls>Ms. 1. 82</ls>. .²3 To plant (as trees). .²4 To depose, dethrone, dismiss, remove (as from a throne <ab>&c.</ab>); मयाऽधिकाराभ्यामवरोप्य <ls>Mu. 3</ls>; चाणक्यं साचिव्यादवरोपयेत्.
